How it works
01

Sourced by name

We buy from eleven farms we visit every year, and we pay them roughly double the commodity rate. Their names are on every bag.

02

Roasted to the hour

Your beans are roasted only after you order, then rested exactly as long as the roast requires. The date is stamped by hand.

03

At your door

Shipped the same week in compostable packaging, arriving at peak flavor. Skip a month or swap roasts in one click.
